final_answer: The element with the chemical symbol W is tungsten, and its atomic number is 74. The symbol "W" is derived from the German name for the element, wolfram. Tungsten is a transition metal in group 6 of the periodic table, and its relative atomic mass is approximately 183.84. It is classified as a d-block element.

Tungsten - Wikipedia
Tungsten is a chemical element ; it has symbol W (from German: Wolfram) [15][16] and atomic number 74 . It is a metal found naturally on Earth almost exclusively in compounds with other elements . It was identified as a distinct element in 1781 and first isolated as a metal in 1783.

Tungsten (W) - Periodic Table
Tungsten is a chemical element of the periodic table with chemical symbol W and atomic number 74 with an atomic weight of 183.841 u and is classed as transition metal and is part of group 6 (chromium group). Tungsten is solid at room temperature.

Tungsten (W) — Element #74 | Periodic Table Online
Tungsten , also known as wolfram, is a chemical element with symbol W and atomic number 74 . The word tungsten comes from the Swedish language tung sten, which directly translates to heavy stone.

The Tungsten ( W ) element is a heavy metal on the periodic table known for its hardness and high melting point. Learn more about element 74 .
